#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <queue>
#include <cmath>
#include <numeric>

using namespace std;

int N, fifty = 0, hundred = 0, K;
int memo[2][51][51];
int memo2[2][51][51][101];
const int MOD = 1000000007;
vector<vector<long long>> comb(101, vector<long long>(101, -1));

int solve(int t, int f, int h);
int solve2(int t, int f, int h, int r);
long long nCk(int n, int k);
int pow_mod(int x, long long p);

int main() {
ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
cin.tie(nullptr);
cin >> N >> K;

vector<int> arr(N);
for(int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    cin >> arr[i];
    if(arr[i] == 50) fifty++;
    else hundred++;
}

for(int i=0; i<2; i++)
    for(int j=0; j<=fifty; j++)
        for(int k=0; k<=hundred; k++)
            memset(memo[i][j], -1, sizeof(int)* (k+1));

for(int i=0; i<=100; i++)
    for(int j=0; j<=100; j++)
        comb[i][j] = -1;

int min_val = solve(0, fifty, hundred);

if(min_val >= 1000000) {
    cout << -1 << '\n' << 0 << '\n';
} else {
    for(int i=0; i<2; i++)
        for(int j=0; j<=fifty; j++)
            for(int k=0; k<=hundred; k++)
                memset(memo2[i][j], -1, sizeof(int)*(k+1)*(min_val+1));

    cout << min_val << '\n' << solve2(0, fifty, hundred, min_val) << '\n';
}

return 0;
}

int solve(int t, int f, int h) {
    if(f == 0 && h == 0)
        return 0;

    if(memo[t][f][h] != -1)
        return memo[t][f][h];

    if(t == 1)
        return memo[t][f][h] = 1 + (f < 50 ? solve(0, f + 1, h) : solve(0, f, h + 1));

    int ans = 1000000;
    for (int i = 0; i <= f; i++) {
        if(i * 50 > K)
            break;

        int j = min((K - i * 50) / 100, h);
        int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;

        if((50 - f + i) > 0 && totalW > 50 || (100 - h + j) > 1 && totalW > 100 || (i == 50 && j == 100))
            continue;

        ans = min(ans, solve(1, f - i, h - j));
    }
    return memo[t][f][h] = ans + 1;
}

int solve2(int t, int f, int h, int r) {
    if(r == 0 && f == 0 && h == 0)
        return 1;

    if(r == 0)
        return 0;

    if(memo2[t][f][h][r] != -1)
        return memo2[t][f][h][r];

    long long ans = 0;
    if(t == 1) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= fifty - f; ++i) {
            if(i * 50 > K)
                break;
            for (int j = 0; j <= hundred - h; ++j) {   
                if(i == 0 && j == 0)
                    continue;
                int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;
                if(totalW > K)
                    break;
                long long ways_f = nCk(fifty - f, i);
                long long ways_h = nCk(hundred - h, j);
                long long mult = (ways_f * ways_h) % MOD;
                long long res = solve2(0, f + i, h + j, r - 1);
                ans = (ans + (mult * res) % MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i <= f; ++i) {
            if(i * 50 > K)
                break;
            for (int j = 0; j <= h; ++j) {   
                if(i == 0 && j == 0)
                    continue;
                int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;
                if(totalW > K)
                    break;
                long long ways_f = nCk(f, i);
                long long ways_h = nCk(h, j);
                long long mult = (ways_f * ways_h) % MOD;
                long long res = solve2(1, f - i, h - j, r - 1);
                ans = (ans + (mult * res) % MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return memo2[t][f][h][r] = (int)ans;
}

long long nCk(int n, int k) {
    if(k < 0 || n < k)
        return 0;
    if(k == 0 || n == k)
        return 1;
    if(comb[n][k] != -1)
        return comb[n][k];
    if(n - k < k)
        return comb[n][k] = nCk(n, n - k);
    long long res = ((long long)n * nCk(n - 1, k - 1)) % MOD;
    long long inv = pow_mod(k, MOD - 2);
    return comb[n][k] = (res * inv) % MOD;
}

int pow_mod(int x, long long p) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long base = x;
    while(p > 0) {
        if(p & 1)
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        p >>= 1;
    }
    return (int)result;
}
